5 min (if you already have the money)

The addons of the {wiki:Nobleman Outfits|Nobleman/Noblewoman Outfit} do not require adventures: you buy them from the stylist {npc:Irmana}, in the Venore fashion house, for 150,000 gp each. You can pay everything at once or in 15 instalments of 10,000 gp. With both addons you get the achievement **Aristocrat**.
One of our finest pieces. If you have the money and want to show how rich and noble you are, this is the outfit for you. We also create addons especially for you, right here.
**Premium** account (the base outfit is available to all Premium players; this quest only gives the addons).
150,000 gp per addon (300,000 gp for both)
Male: **Top Hat** addon (tall hat) and **Coat** addon (coat)
The addons Irmana offers you depend on your character's sex: *top hat* and *coat* for male, *hat* and *dress* for female.
If you start paying for an addon in instalments, you have to finish it before you can start paying for the other one.
Go to **Venore** and go up to the fashion house where {npc:Irmana} is. Say {key:hi}, {key:addon} and {key:yes}. She tells you which addons she has for your character.

Say the name of the addon you want: male — {key:top hat} or {key:coat}; female — {key:hat} or {key:dress}. Then answer {key:yes} to hear the payment terms and {key:yes} again to confirm that you want to buy.
Say {key:paying 150000 at once} to pay everything in one go, or choose the option of 15 instalments of 10,000 gp. Irmana notes down the order and ends the conversation automatically.
If you choose instalments and have already paid the first 10,000 gp, **there is no refund**.
With the money on you, talk to {npc:Irmana} again: {key:hi}, then {key:addon} (or {key:accessory}) and {key:yes}. She collects the amount and hands you the addon.
Repeat section 1 and the previous step for the other addon. With both addons you receive the achievement **Aristocrat**.
